what: The exact source tree both continuous-integration runs checked out at this revision, named by its git tree object. It exists as an artefact entry because several lanes -- the governance lanes and the Phase 2 lanes -- run against SOURCE, not against a built artefact, and binding them to the packaged application's digest would claim they tested bytes they never opened. A lane must name an artefact digest that exists in the manifest; this is the artefact those lanes actually ran against.
